detail.longDescription:
I am building a responsive 3-column product carousel using Mozert Slider ( @mozert-studio/mozert-slider v1.1.3) in a Vanilla JavaScript project, with dynamic pagination bullets enabled. Expected Behavior On desktop viewports ( > 768px ), the slider should display 3 slides at a time with 16px spacing. When resizing the window below 768px , it should switch to 1 slide per view and recalculate the dynamic pagination bullets. Actual Behavior On initial desktop load, all 3 slides render properly. However, when resizing the browser window to mobile width ( 375px ), the slides shrink horizontally instead of switching to a single slide, and the dynamic pagination bullets stay stuck at 3 dots instead of updating to 5 dots. No errors appear in the Chrome DevTools console. Minimal Reproducible Example HTML:
Slide 01
Slide 02
Slide 03
Slide 04
Slide 05
JavaScript: import Mozert from '@mozert-studio/mozert-slider'; import '@mozert-studio/mozert-slider/css'; const slider = new Mozert('.slider', { slidesToShow: 3, spaceBetween: 16, pagination: { type: 'dynamic' }, breakpoints: { 768: { slidesToShow: 1, spaceBetween: 8 } } }); What I have tried Verified that @mozert-studio/mozert-slider/css is loaded properly in the network tab. Tested both mobile-first and desktop-first breakpoint objects, as well as calling slider.update() inside a window resize listener, but the pagination bullet count still does not recalculate. Is there a specific breakpoint syntax or observer option required in Mozert Slider to re-render dynamic pagination on viewport resize?
